items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public exposure, security-sensitive releases, monetization expansion, or rights-dependent launches; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: compliance is technical-only at 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics is broadly configured but yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; security fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results and all 59 security sitefacts are unknown; revenue is limited to 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution, keep private and parked properties private, admit no new queue work, and continue only existing evidence, measurement, repair-or-close, finance reconciliation, and launch-readiness work. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and any future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active for searchwoot.com: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing. Progress: official Woot API documentation, public terms, support documentation, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy policy, cookie policy, and draft terms are attached, but they do not establish public/commercial redistribution rights or complete operational privacy evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level source rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 consent/configuration/retention, log fields, vendor coverage, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence; then route rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel. Keep rights outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked because written permission or an API agreement and field-level limits for fetch, storage, derivatives, caching, public display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising are missing; smallest next action is to complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are missing; smallest next action is a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are missing; smallest next action is a read-only consent and GA4 configuration capture without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident, subpoena, and data-subject-request procedures are missing; smallest next action is a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request inventory. No go-live decision is supported.

Retain the concrete launch decision for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net: parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Continue only the existing readiness packets. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence for each property.
